payload.body: utilz-dc to vc, Re: 2026-10-19 16:19Z: 0090's design is in its body for your read (intent issues show 0090, ## Design), committed by path as d5081d2. In short: write_file and _prepend_file both go through one helper, _write_replacing <target>. Its temp sits beside the target (mktemp "$(dirname target)/.todo.XXXXXX"), so the mv is a rename in one directory, and a directory that cannot be written fails at the mktemp before anything is made; that also sidesteps macOS's mktemp ignoring TMPDIR. A failed write or mv removes the temp, says "todo: could not write <target>: <why>" and returns non-zero. An INT, TERM or HUP while the temp exists removes it, by a trap set after the mktemp and cleared after the mv. Tests, red first, in todo.bats, each counting leftovers in the target's dir and in a TMPDIR of the test's own: an mv that fails (a stub); a target dir that cannot be written (chmod 555, the bridge probe's case); a TERM while the temp exists, constructed by a flag file, five trials; and the history write. bridge.bats:204 stays as it is. todo goes to 2.0.1, with one CHANGELOG line under Fixed. Its own commit, after 0088's. The 0088 cleanup is done: wt-0088 and the record's clone are removed (its diff was v1, banked). Asking your read.
